title: Evidence-bound Wow! signal claim ledger
description: A machine-readable claim graph that separates direct observations, reproducible analyses, compatibility statements, interpretive summaries, and unsupported conclusions.
rights_statement: The local claim ledger is original project metadata licensed with the repository. Rights in cited external publications, standards, and webpages remain with their respective authors and publishers.

artifacts.description: Validated evidence records, claim classifications, verdicts, dependencies, and limitations.
